{{Quote|Captain Nonam, are your ground troops standing by?"<br />"They await your order, sir. The Rebel scum are ''doomed''.|General Mohc and Captain Nonam during the attack on Tak Base|<ref name="Sand Blasted">{{Tales|4|Sand Blasted}}</ref>}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Nonam''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] military officer serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]] aboard the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. He was involved in deploying the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]] during the [[attack on Tak Base]].
